title: Hyderabad - Telangana Building Rules 2012 / GHMC-HMDA (seed)

review.notes: SEED PACK - NOT AUTHORITATIVE. Table structure follows the published bye-laws; the numbers are plausible drafting defaults entered by the Garh AI team from secondary summaries, not transcribed from the primary document. An empanelled local architect must replace every value, confirm every citation, and move the pack to 'reviewed' before it is used on a submission.

disclaimer: Advisory only, not an approval. Every value in this pack is marked 'seed': it was drafted by the Garh AI team from secondary summaries of the bye-laws and has NOT been verified against the primary document or by a local architect. Do not rely on it for a sanction submission. The architect of record remains responsible for compliance; verify each figure against the current bye-laws and any local amendment before signing a drawing.
notes: Telangana's setback table is jointly indexed on plot area and building height, and permissible height is additionally governed by the formula height <= 1.5 x (abutting road width + front setback). This seed pack encodes the plot-area and road-width axes only; the height formula needs a check type that does not exist in schemaVersion 1 and must be added at review rather than approximated. For plots above 500 m2 the real table steps setbacks with height - the single >500 m2 band here is a simplification a reviewer must expand. The floor-count bands are deliberately aligned with the height bands (3 / 4 / 5 / 7 floors against 10 / 15 / 18 / 24 m) so that the two limits are simultaneously satisfiable at a 3 m floor-to-floor; if a reviewer changes one table, the other must be re-checked or the pack will permit a floor count that cannot be built under its own height cap.
